newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungarian share market closes steady, outlook flat.
newsitem.headline: Hungarian share market closes steady, outlook flat.

text.p: 1125 GMT - The Hungarian share market closed virtually unchanged -- with a few points dip in the BUX index on Monday.
* The BUX index closed at a preliminary 5,929.87 points, down 14.59.
* Twelve stocks ended higher, 16 lower and six remained steady.
* The market's new stocks, Riziko Factory and Masodik Deviza Factory traded mixed.
* Pharmaceuticals Human edged a bit higher after its Q1 earnings.
* Oil company MOL closed mixed as subscriptions in its public offer began this morning.
